title: Your Windy: the facts an agent gets about its own Windy platforms and entitlements, every session
x-status: DRAFT 2026-11-02. Grant approved (BOARD 2026-11-02T15:16:05Z, ONE-WINDY plan section E item 7): 'never born clueless', facts only, generated each session from the person's account, started DARK in both runtimes (Windy Fly and Windy Chat's roster). Windy Agent wrote it; Hub (Windy Accounts = the source), Chat (roster rendering), Cloud, Mail, Vault, Search and Eternitas confirm their fields.
description: ONE document per agent per session, assembled LIVE from the platforms (never copied at birth), and ONE rendering of it into a short facts block that both runtimes put in the model's context. Facts only (principle #5): no advice, no sales lines; the model decides when a fact helps. A platform that is not usable is never stated as available (principle #9).
x-rules: Y1 FACTS ONLY. The block states what the agent and its owner HAVE. It never tells the model what to do.
Y2 LIVE. Built at session start from the sources below (cache at most for the session); never copied at birth.
Y3 UNKNOWN IS OMITTED. A field a source didn't answer is left out, never guessed or defaulted.
Y4 ONE SOURCE PER FACT (principle #6): see x-sources.
Y5 PRIVACY: only the AGENT's own addresses and handles, the owner's plan name and storage numbers. Never the owner's email, name, identity id or any content.
Y6 SAME TEXT IN BOTH RUNTIMES: both render by x-render and pass the x-examples vectors byte for byte.
Y7 SIZE: the rendered block stays at or under 1,200 characters; platform lists carry names only; overflow per R9.

Y8 INVALID = OMITTED. A value that fails its schema (every string is ONE line: no control characters, no U+2028/U+2029) is left out, never cleaned or shortened. The block is pasted into the model's context, so a newline in a field could forge a line (Hub, 11-02).

x-sources.agent.passport, passport_status, trust_s: Eternitas GET /api/v1/registry/verify/{passport} (public: passport, status, trust_score, valid; read 2026-11-02)
x-sources.agent.chat_handle: Windy Chat (the agent's own Matrix id from its session) [Chat confirm]
x-sources.plan, platforms[].activated, platforms[]: Windy Accounts: ONE 'my Windy' read [Hub: endpoint + shape]; status = the dashboard tile status
x-sources.entitlements.cloud: Windy Cloud quota read [Cloud: endpoint]; defaults today: free 500 MB per person, 500 MB per agent for the first 3 active agents (Cloud 11-02)

x-render: R2 "You: {agent.name}. Eternitas passport {agent.passport} ({agent.passport_status}, trust score {agent.trust_score})." Omit the parenthesis part that is unknown; omit the line if passport is unknown.
R3 "Your email: {agent.email}" / "Your Windy Chat handle: {agent.chat_handle}": each only when known.

R4 "Windy Cloud storage: {agent_allowance} for you. Your owner's {plan} plan: {person_used} of {person_quota} used." (the two sentences joined by ". "; without a plan: "Your owner's plan"). Sizes are whole MB (bytes / 1048576, rounded down) below 1024 MB, else GB with one decimal. Omit a sentence whose numbers are unknown; omit the line if both are.
R5 "Windy Vault: ready." or "Windy Vault: not set up yet." from entitlements.vault.ready; omit when unknown.
R6 "Windy Search: {used_this_month} of {monthly_allowance} searches used this month." only when both are known.

R7 Platform lines, display names sorted alphabetically, each line only when non-empty: "Activated for your owner: ..." (activated true, any status except coming_soon); "Your owner can activate: ..." (activated false, status active or available); "In preview: ..." (activated false, status preview or developer_api); "Coming soon (not usable yet): ..." (status coming_soon).
R8 Lines joined with a single newline, no trailing newline. Nothing else: no advice, no suggestions, no 'you should' (principle #5).
R9 OVERFLOW (Y7): if the block exceeds 1,200 characters, drop PLATFORM lines from the end (the last first) until it fits; never cut a line.
